mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partial_request ( user_id, partial_type, partial_kind, partial_area, partial_addr, partial_friend) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{partialType}, #{partialKind}, #{partialArea}, #{partialAddr}, #{partialFriend} )
mapper.select: SELECT partial_request_id AS partialRequestId, user_id AS userId, partial_type AS partialType, partial_kind AS partialKind, partial_area AS partialArea, partial_addr AS partialAddr, partial_friend AS partialFriend, created_at AS createdAt, status AS status FROM partial_request WHERE partial_request_id = #{partialRequestId}
